clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Letter to Jin'Zil carries word of Serena Bloodfeather's defeat. Darsok Swiftdagger sends it to the Darkspear witch doctor in the Stonetalon Mountains, telling him the northern Barrens are free of the Bloodfeather threat.

After the harpies at the Dry Hills are wiped out and Serena Bloodfeather is slain, Darsok Swiftdagger writes to an old comrade. The harpies of the Barrens first roosted in the peaks of the Stonetalon Mountains. Darsok sends news of the fallen matron to Jin'Zil, a witch doctor, and introduces a promising warrior to the wider frontier.
